facts.fact: Nimmi reaches Garh Neshar on the second grain cart the hill council allows through, two days after the Fair, to amputate Meera's ring and little fingers; she then stays nine days to help draft the law.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Nimmi take the fingers, and Ranu is a day and a half from Garh Neshar and the rope forbids Meera leaving Rohan.

facts.fact: While counting through the amputation, Meera names the people she has carried in order and, after 206, adds Rohan as 207.
facts.why: needed because the beat has her count aloud while he counts with her; ties to the 206 total in F077.

facts.fact: Rohan has a left glove made for Meera: felted wool lined with lambskin, cut for a thumb and three fingers. He measured her hand with a cord while she slept, because the numb left hand cannot feel frost.
facts.why: needed for technique 9 (responsive care); builds on F182 and the numb left hand in ch29.

facts.fact: Drafting takes six weeks in the guest-house at Garh Neshar and produces an eleven-line law; Kunal visits twice. Licences carry two seals, the Shilak post's and the hill council's. Ila measures Rohan's arm against the post door and fixes the rope limit as twelve spans of the guide's own arm.
facts.why: needed to show the collaborative drafting the beat calls for; Ila corrects distances per her character.

facts.fact: The dispatches say Varun lies in the Garh Neshar cellar and goes to Taravan in chains when the passes open, and Pritam is held in his own seat. The assembly's paper says the regent's general is exiled across the border; Nimmi says Ranu will tell it otherwise. Rohan never learns the grey-bearded officer's name.
facts.why: needed for the beat's news, and plants C24 without naming Tej.

facts.fact: Rohan promises Meera he will not hand her to anyone, though he has not worked out how the writ will say so; the rope hums level. In the night scene he also promises, 'I will stay.'
facts.why: needed so Rohan can honestly address the writ's order to deliver the Salt Fox without resolving it, which is left for chapter 32; and for 'Stay' to be answered on the page.

facts.fact: Ila stays in Garh Neshar to finish her map when Meera and Rohan leave. They cross back with the writ naming Meera as his guide, and see the Shilak Cairn from the last ridge two or three nights before the thaw.
facts.why: needed to set up chapter 32's cairn scene and its note that Ila stayed in Neshar.
